cards.question: When is a Condvar used?
cards.answer: To notify one or more threads of an event when the shared data is protected by a Mutex.

cards.question: What does Condvar::wait do with the MutexGuard?
cards.answer: It takes the guard, unlocks the mutex, and sleeps. On notification it re-locks the mutex and returns the guard.

cards.question: What is the difference between notify_one and notify_all?
cards.answer: notify_one wakes a single waiting thread. notify_all wakes all waiting threads.
